leads.text: Front End collapsed from 27% of postings in early 2022 to 6.6% now. That is the number that matters in the latest HN "Who is Hiring" breakdown. The thread itself is thin - 244 jobs in November, 37% below last year, and August's 224 was the fewest since January 2014. Fewer seats, and the seats that remain changed shape: AI is in 51.6% of postings, agents at 14.8% now outrank LLMs at 10.7%. # hiring # frontend https:// links.madcoolsocial.com/AnMDxAy
leads.author: Madcoolsocial
